notes.title: Game Performance Update
notes.notes:
We’ve rolled out a new client update designed to make your gameplay smoother, faster, and more responsive.

This update focuses on:

Better performance on modern systems.

Reduced lag spikes during battles and large-scale events.

Improved stability for a more consistent experience.

We encourage everyone to update and test it out. Your feedback is important — let us know how it feels in both PvP and PvE!

Thanks for playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: The Scavenger Event returns from June 19, 2025 at 12:00 AM PST to August 2, 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]The Scavenger Event returns from June 19, 2025 at 12:00 AM PST to August 2, 2025 at 11:59 PM PST![/h1]

Collect Scavenger Tokens and exchange them for high-tier rewards.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]

[h3]🎁 1,500 Platinum Tokens[/h3]  
Prizes are guaranteed and randomly chosen within your selected category!  
[b]Choose one category to receive a Random High-Tier Warrior or Random High-Tier Mage item.[/b] Each item within your chosen category has an equal 25% chance of being awarded.

[list]
[*][b]⚔ Warrior Items[/b] (items are not character bound):
  [list]
  [*]Sword of Medusa
  [*]Kloness Blade
  [*]Demon Slayer
  [*]Lighting Blade
  [/list]
[*][b]📖 Mage Items[/b] (items are not character bound):
  [list]
  [*]Necklace of The Beholder
  [*]Resurrection Wand (MS.10)
  [*]Ice Storm
  [*]Kloness Wand (MS.10)
  [/list]
[/list]

[h3]🎁 300 Gold Tokens[/h3]  
[b]Magic Necklace (DM+1)[/b] – 100% guaranteed

[h3]🎁 300 Silver Tokens[/h3]  
[b]Magic Necklace (MS10)[/b] – 100% guaranteed

[h2]Monsters & Token Drops[/h2]

[b]Platinum Tokens drop from:[/b]  
[list]
[*]Abaddon (Drops multiple stacks of 100 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Tigerworm (Drops a stack of 30 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Wyvern (Drops multiple stacks of 5 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Fire Wyvern (Drops multiple stacks of 10 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Helclaw (Drops a stack of 25 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Liche (Drops 1 Platinum Token)
[*]Dark Elf (Drops 1 Platinum Token)
[*]Barlog (Drops a stack of 20 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Master Mage Orc (Drops a stack of 15 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Giant Lizard (Drops a stack of 10 Platinum Tokens)
[*]Centaurus (Drops a stack of 10 Platinum Tokens)

[h2]Token Restrictions[/h2]

[list]
[*]All tokens (Platinum, Gold, Silver) are character-bound.
[*]Tokens cannot be dropped, transferred, or traded.
[*]Only the character who collected them can redeem them.
[*]Tokens will be removed after the event ends and will not carry over to future events.
[*][b]Be sure to claim your rewards before August 2, 2025![/b]
[/list]

[h2]Additional Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*]Smaller trees when using the medium detail level.
[*]Increased Dark Elf Bow damage. The base damage is now 2D9 (small and large), meaning damage can range from 2 to 18.
[*]Adjusted monster pits in Icebound.
[/list]

notes.title: Crusade War is Coming!
notes.notes:
[b]Brace for war![/b] The legendary [b]Crusade[/b] returns to the battlefield not once, but [u]twice every week[/u]!

[b]🗓️ Crusade Schedule:[/b]
[list]  [*]📍 [b]Wednesdays[/b] at [b]4:00 PM PST[/b][/*]  [*]📍 [b]Saturdays[/b] at [b]8:00 AM PST[/b][/*][/list][h3]🛡️ What is a Crusade?[/h3]
A [b]Crusade[/b] in Helbreath is an epic portal war between the cities of [b]Elvine[/b] and [b]Aresden[/b]. The goal is to lead your city to victory by destroying the enemy’s base buildings. But be warned—these structures can’t be destroyed by normal attacks.

To bring down enemy buildings, your city must operate its [b]Grand Magic Generator[/b] to unleash powerful [u]Metheo-Strikes[/u]. Buildings offer safety to players—until they’re hit by magic. Once a city’s [b]Energy Shield Generator[/b] is destroyed, all other buildings fall with it.
[h3]🚫 Civilian Restrictions[/h3][list]  [*][b]Civilians cannot participate[/b] in the Crusade War Event.[/*]  [*]Civilians are restricted to remain within their town and [b]cannot enter Middleland[/b] during the Crusade.[/*][/list][h3]🔧 Builders (Constructors)[/h3][list]  [*]You must be in a Guild to become a Builder.[/*]  [*]Constructors gather mana by building a [b]Mana Collector[/b] near the [b]Mana Stone[/b] in Middleland.[/*]  [*]Only a [b]Guildmaster[/b] can become a [b]Commander[/b].[/*][/list][h3]🏗️ Builder Structures:[/h3][list]  [*][b]Arrow Guard Tower:[/b] Defends with arrows[/*]  [*][b]Cannon Guard Tower:[/b] Defends with cannon fire[/*]  [*][b]Mana Collector:[/b] Harvests mana and restores nearby mana[/*]  [*][b]Detector:[/b] Alerts when enemy approaches (even invisible)[/*][/list][h3]⚔️ Soldiers[/h3][list]  [*]Anyone not in a Guild can participate as a Soldier.[/*]  [*]Earn [b]EXP[/b] and [b]Contribution Points[/b] by defeating enemies or destroying buildings.[/*]  [*]If victorious, receive bonus EXP and gold![/*]  [*]Soldiers follow commands from their Commander or the system AI.[/*][/list][h3]📋 Important Rules[/h3][list]  [*]No chatting with or seeing names of enemy players.[/*]  [*]You can tell if a player is an enemy or ally without hovering your cursor.[/*]  [*]If you die twice in under 10 minutes, you’ll be confined to your city for 3 minutes.[/*]  [*]Summon stronger war units by raising summon points through kills.[/*]  [*]Monster EXP gain is greatly reduced during Crusade battles.[/*][/list]
Visit the [b]City Hall[/b] to choose your role before battle begins. Whether you construct the war effort or fight on the front lines, your city needs you!
